readiness_gate: Publish/process prefix only; assert persisted sustained_high flag non-null and ML ready at 2016-05-01T13:10:00 before publishing remaining records. Resume unchanged worker with committed DB state.
history_rationale: Minimum is 18 same-hour observations from >=3 previous dates within seven calendar days; use a full seven-day prefix, not shortened windows. At the gate require all 24 frozen/current hour references available; current-day samples excluded.
limits: Exactly two fixed scenarios, no tuning/training/full tests/CI/screenshots; retain private DB/Kafka/API for next stages. Historical dataset timestamps are timezone-naive. Not a performance or independent scientific experiment.
